notes: Merged from samurai-newa-1992. The receipt runs in both directions. The NeWA’s own founding post of 9 September 1991 quotes “Kamakaze and Samurai, former WeWF tag team members, currently NeWA Tag Team Champions”; the Summit of E-Wrestling’s own opening night of 10 July 1991 says of that same pair “I haven’t seen them in the WeWF in a long time, but I’ve heard that they went to Japan and now hold the NeWA Tag Team Titles”, and names the federation in full later on the same card — “the Nippon electronic Wrestling Association”. Each institution’s own document names the other’s, with the same partner and the same tag-team championship. The Summit tenure above is folded in from that row; data/aliases.json redirects samurai-summit to this id. Two things are recorded rather than reconciled: the NeWA’s own first weekly report of 27 September 1991 lists him in the Imperial Storm with Bushi rather than with Kamakaze, three weeks after the founding post; and his WeWF past is attested by both documents and staged by neither, so no WeWF tenure is minted from it.
